buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Transportation and Delivery: The quoted price shall be inclusive of all charges towards packing, han dling, transportation and delivery of the tablet to the designated consignee location. No additional charges shall be claimed by the supplier towards delivery or any related services. 2. Product Quality and Condition: The tablet supplied shall be brand new, unused, genuine products m anufactured by the original equipment manufacturer (OEM). Refurbished, reconditioned, second-hand or di scontinued models shall not be accepted. 3. Technical Specifications: The supplied tablet shall strictly conform to the technical specifications me ntioned in the GeM bid, including processor, RAM, internal storage, display size, operating system, battery capacity and connectivity features. Any deviation from the prescribed specifications shall not be accepted. 4. Warranty: The supplier shall provide a minimum comprehensive manufacturer's warranty of 1 year fro m the date of successful delivery and acceptance of the tablet. Any manufacturing defects or hardware-rel ated issues arising during the warranty period shall be rectified or the defective components replaced with out any additional cost. 5. After-Sales Service: The supplier shall ensure adequate after-sales service and technical support thro ugh the manufacturer or its authorised service centres. The supplier shall facilitate warranty claims, repair s and replacement of defective components during the warranty period. 6. Accessories: Each tablet shall be supplied along with all standard accessories, including original charg er, USB charging cable, user manual and other accessories required for its normal operation. The cost of all such accessories shall be included in the quoted price. 7. Operating System and Software: The tablet shall be supplied with a genuine, licensed and pre- installed operating system, with all necessary system drivers and essential software. The operating syste m shall be eligible for regular security updates and manufacturer-supported upgrades, wherever applicabl e. 8. IMEI / Serial Number Details: The supplier shall furnish the make, model, serial number and IMEI nu mber (where applicable) of each tablet at the time of delivery. These details shall be recorded in the deliv ery challan and invoice for inventory and warranty tracking purposes. 9. Installation and Demonstration: The supplier shall provide initial device configuration, activation an d demonstration of basic operations to the concerned staff at the consignee location. All devices shall be h anded over in fully functional condition. 10. Inspection and Acceptance: The tablet shall be subject to physical inspection and verification of tec hnical specifications by the consignee or an authorised representative before acceptance. Payment shall b

e processed only after satisfactory delivery, verification and acceptance of the supplied items. 11. Replacement of Defective Items: If tablet found damaged, defective, non-functional or not conform ing to the prescribed specifications at the time of delivery shall be replaced by the supplier with a new dev ice of the same or higher specifications, without any additional financial liability to the purchaser. 12. Documentation: The supplier shall submit the original tax invoice, warranty certificate, product speci fications and user manuals along with the supplied tablet. All relevant documents shall be handed over to the consignee at the time of delivery. 13. Delivery Period: The supplier shall complete the supply of tablet within the delivery period stipulated in the GeM contract. Any delay in delivery shall be dealt with as per the applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions. 14. Compliance with GeM Conditions: The supplier shall comply with all applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions, bid-specific requirements and Government procurement guidelines. The supply shall be co mpleted strictly in accordance with the terms and conditions of the GeM contract. .
